questions.question:
How many triangles are there in the given figure?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e6d0369af3d38674250704eb6d34dc72839b4e0cca1ad115b56e3e95df4ff257.png]
questions.solution: The number of triangles in the given figure is shown below: 1) Number of triangles = [Number of parts x (1 + Number of parts)] ÷ 2 = Total triangles = [2 x (1 + 2)] ÷ 2 = [2 x 3] ÷ 2 = 6 ÷ 2 = 3

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(**NOTE :** Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding / deleting / multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

(40, 8, 24)

(60, 12, 36)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is: 

Logic: 2nd number × 5 = 1st number. 2nd number × 3 = 3rd number..

Now,

For (40, 8, 24):

⇒ 8 × 5 = 40

⇒ 8 × 3 = 24

For (60, 12, 36)

⇒ 12 × 5 = 60

⇒ 12 × 3 = 36

Similarly, for **Option 3: (70, 14, 42)**

**⇒ 14 × 5 = 70 **

**⇒ 14 × 3 = 42 **

Hence, the correct answer is Option 3.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term and the sixth term is related to the fifth term.

8 ∶ 17 ∶∶ 14 ∶ ? ∶∶ 20 ∶ 41
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: (1st number × 2) + 1 = 2nd number.

Now,

For, 8 ∶ 17

⇒ (8 × 2) + 1 = 16 + 1 = 17.

For, 20 ∶ 41

⇒ (20 × 2) + 1 = 40 + 1 = 41.

Similarly, for 14 ∶ ?

**⇒ (14 × 2) + 1 = 28 + 1 = 29.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question:
Two statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All Peanuts are Almonds.

All Almonds are Butters.

**Conclusions:**

I. All Butters are Almonds.

II. All Peanuts are Butters.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2bd22538a586900626f97679a69a767d2daba82b983bfdb87adb78064faf94ae.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All Butters are Almonds → Does not follow (As all Almonds are Butters. So it is possible but not definite.)

II. All Peanuts are Butters → Follow (As all Peanuts are Almonds and all Peanuts are Butters. As whole peanuts comes in almonds which whole comes in butters, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion II follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
